notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Started hosted API trial 2025-11-20 to validate chat + embeddings flows; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and data residency.

Highlights / quotes:
- "Hosted API latency was great for low traffic but spikes caused timeouts during demos" — Head of Product
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market unit economics; want per-token cost predictable, aiming to keep inference costs <= 5% of gross margin.

Trial findings (hosted API):
- Baseline QPS observed: 12 qps average during weekday usage window (09:00-18:00 PT)
- Peak bursts: 48-55 qps during feature launch tests (10-15 minute spikes)
- Measured concurrency: sustained 18 concurrent generator sessions, peak 32
- Token mix: ~62% short chat interactions (<512 tokens total), ~28% mid-length (512-2048), ~10% long-form (>=2048)
- Avg input tokens per request: 120; avg generated tokens: 420; avg total tokens/request: ~540
- Model preference during trial: open LLM (Redwood-verified), prefer 8-bit quantization for cost, want fallback to smaller model during overload

Requests from customer:
- Sizing ask: estimate Dedicated capacity to support 100 qps sustained with 4x headroom for bursts (target bursts up to 400 qps), P95 latency < 300ms for short chats
- Forecasting: plan for 6-9 months ramp (trial->pilot->prod) with projected QPS growth 12 -> 70 -> 160
- Need a cost model: per-token hosted -> dedicated delta + infra commit scenarios
- Compliance: require SOC 2 + data residency in US/EU depending on customer segment

POC/Demo activity:
- 2025-11-20: Signup + quickstart, sample app integration (SE: Ravi)
- 2025-12-08: Live demo for product team (fireflies ff-20251208-0910)
- 2026-01-15: Hosted trial stress test (peak 55 qps) — captured logs and token distribution
- 2026-02-10: Pricing review call with finance (AE: Jamie) — discussed committed capacity tiers
- 2026-02-18: Security questionnaire submitted; waiting on data residency confirmation from infra

Next steps (short):
- Deliver Dedicated sizing workbook with recommended GPU equivalents + concurrency targets (action: SE to finalize workbook)
- Provide 3 pricing scenarios (12-mo commit, 36-mo commit, on-demand burst pricing)
- Legal/Procurement: get initial redlines on SLA and residency clause

Notes on architecture preferences / routing:
- Prefer Smart routing: route EU customers to EU dedicated pool; fall back to hosted API only for non-sensitive traffic
- KV/prefix caching critical for chat sessions to reduce token costs

Open asks for Redwood:
- Confirm recommended Dedicated instance mix for 100 qps sustained (guidance on GPU counts, memory, and estimated tokens/s GPU)
- Sample cost simulation for current token mix and forecasted growth
- Timeline: customer wants production-ready Dedicated in 8-12 weeks after contract

AE/SE sentiment: positive; product loves the Console metrics. Procurement timeline is the main risk.
